```yaml
name: Nuitka Linux Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install nuitka

    - name: Build project using Nuitka
      run: |
        nuitka --standalone --onefile --include-package=dirsearch dirsearch.py

    - name: Rename output file to match expected naming convention
      run: |
        mv dist/dirsearch.dist/dirsearch dist/dirsearch-linux

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: dirsearch-linux
        path: dist/dirsearch-linux
```
